methods.description: Connects a bot and resolves once it has spawned. The `done` record names the new bot.
methods.name: createBot

oneOf.description: No account: servers with `online-mode=false` (LAN, most test servers).

A Microsoft account signed in by device code, its tokens cached per `username` (an `msaCode` record asks a
person to sign in when the cache has none).

EventGroup.description:
A group of events a bot can report (acacia-bot's `Events`). Opt-in and high-rate: `ticks` (`physicsTick`, 20 a
second) and `entityMoves` (once per tick batch); `entities` and `entityMoves` need `entities`.

autoRespawn.description:
Press "respawn" about 2 s after dying, as a player reading the death screen would (default true; off, call
`bot.respawn`).

entities.description:
Track entities and other players, needed for their positions, entity events, `follow` and `attack`
(default false: on busy servers it is most of the decode work).

events.description: Event groups reported from the start (default none; `bot.setEvents` changes them).

physics.description: Simulate movement and track terrain, needed to walk (default false).

transport.description: Default `auto`: RakNet if the server answers a ping, else NetherNet.

username.description:
The player name (`offline`), or the account's key in the token cache (`microsoft`: the server sees the
Xbox gamertag).

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

methods.description:
Signs a Microsoft account in without connecting, so later `createBot` calls find its tokens cached: an
`msaCode` record asks a person to sign in when the cache has none. Fails `AUTH` (see the code).
methods.name: signIn

profilesFolder.description:
Where tokens are cached, one `<username>.json` each (default `~/.acacia/auth` of the host's user). Holds
refresh tokens: keep it private. acacia-daemon sets it itself and refuses this.

username.description: The account's key in the token cache, as `createBot`'s `username`.

displayName.description: The Xbox gamertag servers will see.

methods.description:
Disconnects the bot (waiting up to 2 s for the server to free the session). The running call is
cancelled and queued ones fail with `DISCONNECTED`; an `end` event comes before this resolves.
methods.name: bot.close

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

methods.description: Cancels call `call`: removed if still queued, ended within a tick if running. Fails with `CANCELLED`.
methods.name: cancel

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

CallId.description: The caller's id for one call, echoed in its `done` record. A plain number: the caller picks it (below 2^53).

methods.description:
Cancels a `createBot` or `signIn` call that has no bot yet (signing in, connecting or retrying its join): it
fails with `CANCELLED`. A call that has already settled, or whose bot has spawned, is left alone.
methods.name: cancelCall

CallId.description: The caller's id for one call, echoed in its `done` record. A plain number: the caller picks it (below 2^53).

methods.description: The bot's state now, built on demand.
methods.name: bot.snapshot

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

ColdSnapshot.description: Changes on inventory, effect and player-list updates.

version.description: Moves exactly when the cold part is rebuilt (0 in an on-demand snapshot), so readers can cache on it.

Entity.description: A tracked entity or other player (acacia-bot's `EntityInfo`). `kind`, not `type`: events are tagged by `type`.

health.description: When the server sent it (mobs; players' health is not broadcast).

uniqueId.description: The id player lists and containers name.

velocity.description: The last velocity the server sent.

EntityId.description: An entity's runtime id (the per-connection one actions take), as a decimal string.

gameMode.description: The protocol's game mode number (0 survival, 1 creative, 2 adventure, 6 spectator).

tick.description: Client ticks since the bot connected (0 when the bot does not publish snapshots).

velocity.description: Physics bots only (zero otherwise), like `onGround` and `gliding`.

Stack.description: A non-empty stack, summarised. `networkId` is the server's item id; names come from its item table.

UniqueId.description: An entity's unique id (the one player lists and containers name), as a decimal string.

result.description: The bot's state at one moment.

entities.description: Empty unless the bot tracks entities.

result.title: Snapshot

methods.description: Changes the event groups the bot reports.
methods.name: bot.setEvents

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

EventGroup.description:
A group of events a bot can report (acacia-bot's `Events`). Opt-in and high-rate: `ticks` (`physicsTick`, 20 a
second) and `entityMoves` (once per tick batch); `entities` and `entityMoves` need `entities`.

methods.description: Sends a chat line.

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

methods.description: Runs a slash command (the leading `/` is optional).
methods.name: bot.command

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

command.description: The command line, e.g. `/time set day`.

methods.description: Walks to a goal (physics bots only). Fails with `NOT_POSSIBLE` when there is no path.
methods.name: bot.goto

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

Goal.description: Where `bot.goto` walks to; `range` is Euclidean, in blocks.

oneOf.description: At least `range` from the cell: fleeing it.

methods.description: Breaks the block at a cell, as a player would (reach, tool, mining time).
methods.name: bot.dig

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: The block cell `x, y, z` to break.
params.title: DigParams

methods.description: Answers an open form after a human reading delay.
methods.name: bot.answerForm

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

FormAnswer.description: An answer to an open form; one that does not fit the form is refused before anything is sent.

oneOf.description: Simple form: the button index (buttons only, not labels or headers).
Custom form: one value per input element, in order.
A dropdown option or step-slider step.

form.description: The form's id, from its `form` event.

methods.description: Lets ticks pass (50 ms each) while the bot keeps playing.
methods.name: bot.waitForTicks

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

methods.description:
Keeps within `range` of a tracked entity, walking after it, until cancelled (physics and entity tracking).
Never resolves on its own: it ends with `CANCELLED`, or `DISCONNECTED`.
methods.name: bot.follow

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

EntityId.description: An entity's runtime id (the per-connection one actions take), as a decimal string.

range.description: Blocks (Euclidean) to keep within; 2 when absent.

methods.description: Turns the bot's eyes to a point.
methods.name: bot.lookAt

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: A world point the bot turns its eyes to.
params.title: LookAtParams

methods.description: Swings at a tracked entity in reach. `NOT_POSSIBLE` out of reach or unknown, `NOT_VISIBLE` behind blocks.
methods.name: bot.attack

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

EntityId.description: An entity's runtime id (the per-connection one actions take), as a decimal string.

methods.description:
Holds or releases a movement key (physics bots). An action that moves the bot overrides the keys while it
runs, and every queued call releases them when it ends.
methods.name: bot.setControlState

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

methods.description: Releases every movement key.
methods.name: bot.clearControlStates

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

methods.description:
Moves an item from the main inventory to the hand (selected in the hotbar), an armour slot or the off hand.
`NOT_POSSIBLE` when the inventory has none.
methods.name: bot.equip

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

item.description: An item name (`minecraft:stone`, or just `stone`) in the main inventory.

methods.description:
Places the held block against a face of a block, waiting until the server shows it (`REJECTED` if it never
does).
methods.name: bot.placeBlock

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: Places the held block against `face` of the block at `x, y, z`.

face.description: `up` when absent: on top of the block.

params.title: PlaceBlockParams

methods.description: The nearest loaded blocks with any of the names, read from the bot's terrain without waiting for an action.
methods.name: bot.findBlocks

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

count.description: How many to return, nearest first; 1 when absent, at most 1024.

maxDistance.description: Blocks from the bot's feet (Euclidean); 16 when absent, at most 64.

methods.description:
Crafts an item from the inventory through the recipe book, in the bot's own 2x2 grid or at a crafting table
(`table`, within reach). `NOT_POSSIBLE` when no recipe fits the grid or ingredients are missing.
methods.name: bot.craft

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

count.description: How many items at least; 1 when absent. A craft makes a recipe's whole output (4 sticks), so more may come.

item.description: The item to make (`minecraft:stick`, or just `stick`).

table.description: The crafting table to use, within reach; the bot's own 2x2 grid when absent.

crafted.description: Items made: `count` or more, fewer only when the ingredients ran out after at least one craft.

methods.description: The server's recipes that make an item, with what each uses up and where it is made.
methods.name: bot.recipesFor

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

item.description: The item to make (`minecraft:stick`, or just `stick`).
An item name, `#tag` for any item with that tag (`#minecraft:planks`), or a MoLang item expression.

Recipe.description: One server recipe, its ingredients summed over the grid.

fits2x2.description: Fits the bot's own 2x2 grid (no crafting table needed).

station.description: Where it is made: `crafting_table` (a 2x2 recipe too), `furnace`, `stonecutter`, `smithing_table`, ...

methods.description: What a chest, barrel or other container holds: opens it (within reach), reads it and closes it.
methods.name: bot.containerContents

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

item.description: The item's name, or `#<network id>` for one missing from the server's item table.

items.description: The non-empty slots, in slot order.

methods.description:
Puts items from the inventory into a chest, barrel or other container (within reach). `NOT_POSSIBLE` when the
inventory has none of the item or the container is full.
methods.name: bot.deposit

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: Moves items of one kind between the container at `x, y, z` and the bot's main inventory.

count.description: How many at most; all there are when absent.

params.title: TransferParams

moved.description: Items moved: fewer than `count` once the source has no more or the other side is full.

methods.description:
Takes items out of a chest, barrel or other container (within reach) into the inventory. `NOT_POSSIBLE` when
the container has none of the item or the inventory is full.
methods.name: bot.withdraw

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: Moves items of one kind between the container at `x, y, z` and the bot's main inventory.

count.description: How many at most; all there are when absent.

params.title: TransferParams

moved.description: Items moved: fewer than `count` once the source has no more or the other side is full.

methods.description:
Smelts items at a furnace, blast furnace or smoker (within reach): puts them and any fuel in, waits until they
are done (10 s an item in a furnace, 5 s otherwise), takes the output and closes it.
methods.name: bot.smelt

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: Smelts items in the furnace, blast furnace or smoker at `x, y, z` (within reach).

fuel.description: Fuel to add (`coal`); none when absent, for a furnace that still burns.

fuelCount.description: How much fuel; 1 when absent (one coal smelts 8 items).

item.description: The item to smelt (`minecraft:raw_iron`, or just `raw_iron`).

params.title: SmeltParams

smelted.description: Items taken out of the output slot.

methods.description:
Eats or drinks: the held item, or `item` taken into the hand first. Resolves once the server has consumed it.
`NOT_POSSIBLE` for something inedible, or food while not hungry.
methods.name: bot.consume

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

item.description: A food or drink to take into the hand first; the held item when absent.

methods.description: Throws items out of the inventory, a stack at a time. `NOT_POSSIBLE` when it has none.
methods.name: bot.toss

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

count.description: How many at most; all the inventory has when absent.

toward.description: A point to look at first, so the items fly that way (a player's eyes); where the bot looks when absent.

methods.description:
Right-clicks a block with the held item, facing it first: opens doors, gates and trapdoors, presses buttons
and levers, uses beds, crafting tables and containers. Resolves once the click is sent, without waiting for
the block to change. `NOT_POSSIBLE` out of reach, `NOT_VISIBLE` when blocks hide it.
methods.name: bot.activateBlock

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.

params.description: The block cell `x, y, z` to right-click.

face.description: The face to click when the bot sees it, else one it sees; `up` when absent.

params.title: ActivateBlockParams

methods.description:
Uses the held item in the air: eats, drinks, throws, draws a bow, raises a shield. Food finishes on its own;
a bow, crossbow or shield stays in use until `bot.deactivateItem`.

methods.name: bot.deactivateItem

methods.description:

methods.description:
Presses "respawn" on the death screen; a `respawn` event follows once the server has moved the bot. Bots
respawn on their own unless created with `autoRespawn: false`. `NOT_POSSIBLE` while alive.
methods.name: bot.respawn

BotId.description: A bot the host runs, named by the host when `createBot` is called.
